technical_and_design_decisions: RabbitMQ sink batching (U1) will leverage Spring AMQP's BatchingRabbitTemplate with configurable batchingEnabled, batchSize, and bufferLimit properties.
The Gradle build support (U2) will provide a dedicated plugin or task configuration block targeting Spring XD module projects, supporting the 'MODULE' layout and 'provided' dependency scope.
Acceptance tests for the hdfs-dataset module (U3) will run against an embedded/mini HDFS cluster during the CI build process.
Extensible compression support (U4) will introduce a strategy interface (e.g., ContentCodec or CompressionStrategy) allowing custom implementation injection via spring-xd-module configuration.
Database bypass for DIRT runtime (U7) will introduce an in-memory or disabled state for the relational database repository when stream processing alone is active.
RxJava processor interface implementation (U8) will adapt Spring Messaging MessageHandler / Processor contracts to RxJava Observable streams.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed by a single developer familiar with Spring XD, Spring Integration, and Gradle plugin development.
Workdays are based on standard 8-hour working days.
A local CI and benchmark test environment (RabbitMQ, HDFS mini-cluster) is available for running performance baselines and acceptance tests.
Upstream dependency on Spring Boot issue #2187 (for U2) is either resolved or can be addressed via explicit plugin configuration workaround.

activities.activity_description: Add batching configuration options to the RabbitMQ sink module, integrate BatchingRabbitTemplate, and add unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Gradle Build Option for Spring XD Modules (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement Gradle build options/plugin configuration for module projects to support 'provided' dependencies and Boot 'MODULE' layout.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Test Coverage for HDFS-Dataset Module (U3)
activities.activity_description: Develop automated acceptance tests covering hdfs-dataset sink/source functionalities and integrate them into the CI build pipeline.
Refactor compression strategy interfaces to enable custom codec registration and override default compression behaviors.
Set up performance benchmark scripts with batching enabled (batchingSize=100 and varying sizes), execute runs, and generate comparative report.
Re-run baseline performance benchmarks with RabbitMQ compression enabled and evaluate throughput and latency against previous snapshots.

activities.activity_name: Disable DB Requirement Option for DIRT Runtime (U7)
activities.activity_description: Modify DIRT runtime bootstrap and container configurations to allow execution without a relational database when running stream-only workloads.
Implement the core reactive processor contract adapting Spring XD message streams to RxJava API, including a sample RxJava processor module and tests.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all updated modules and update reference documentation for new configuration options.
